name: Kindan no Paradise
source:
Saori drifts to the island where the two female tribes confront compete for the selection of a next queen. Saori will search for "the dew of love of the goddess" which is a condition for becoming a queen .

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
沙织漂流到一座岛上。岛上的两个女性部族正在争斗，试图选出下一任女王。为了满足成为女王的条件，沙织将寻找“女神的爱之露”。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
